the accident. there were [roadway]. there were no crosswalks present or presumed crosswalks. the roadway was poorly lit and a line of trees on the west side of oaklawn blocked any lighting from the apartments [roadway]. there was no blood present on the roadway either. unit 1, driven by vincent jonathan, is a 2015 hyundai tucson bearing tx paper tag 6911l45. jonathan stated he was travelling [roadway] at approximately 18 mph. jonathan stated he saw a woman on the curb as he struck something in the roadway. jonathan immediately stopped his vehicle and got out to see what he hit. jonathan stated he attempted to feel for a pulse but has very limited medical training. while assessing jonathan's vehicle, damage was noted on the front right corner approximately 1 o'clock. jonathan stated and bottom of the hood, and a gap between the front right wheel well and front bumper clip. there was no airbag deployment, no blood visible on the car, and no broken glass. no clothing fibers or hairs from the pt were visible either. capt. watson contacted the hpdps criminal investigation division who were contacting an accident investigator for consultation. jonathan stated he does not have insurance on the vehicle. jonathan was cited for no sr insurance citation number [identifier]. a vehicle inventory was taken, and the vehicle was impounded by jordan's towing at [roadway] in plano, [medical facility] revealed the pt was now deceased. a fatality hold was placed on the vehicle for further investigation. a phone number was obtained through a 911 call for the granddaughter who was on scene. no name was available at the time of this report. she can be reached at [phone].

records.deidentified_narrative: unit 1 [roadway] 19, [roadway] 4622. unit 2, a pedestrian, departed his residence at 8301 sh 19, with the intention of walking to a store. unit 2 walked north a short distance, [roadway] 19. unit 2 failed to yield the right of way, and was struck by unit 1's front distributed on his left side. unit 2 wrapped over the hood and roof of unit 1, which caused the windshield to shatter and collapse resulting in serious injury to the operator. unit 2 came to a rest in the roadway south of the area of impact. unit 1 continued traveling south a considerable distance, as the operator was incapacitated. unit 1 eventually veered off the right (west) side of the roadway, and struck a tree with its front concentrated. the second collision occurred in the parking lot of 8650 sh 19, approximately 0. 37 miles south of the initial area of impact. operator of unit 1 was life-flighted to ut health in tyler for serious head lacerations. unit 2 was pronounced deceased on scene by justice of the peace tanya norris. operator of unit 1 tested positive for amphetamines in a urine sample taken by medical personnel at ut health. however, the detection was the result of the operator's prescription for vyvanse, and the presence of amphetamine did not contribute or play a factor in this crash. a toxicology screen performed during unit 2's autopsy did not detect the presence of drugs or alcohol.
